This application coming on for hearing this day, the co  following:
 ORDER
This is the second repeat bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail.
His earlier bail application was rejected on merit vide order dated 11.11.2022 passed in MCRC No.50108/2022 by this Court.

The applicant is in custody since 13.10.2022 in connection with Crime No.22/2016 registered at Police Station EOW,
District Indore (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of the Indian Penal Code of 1860.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is an innocent person and he has been falsely implicated in this offence.
He is in custody since 13.10.2022.
After rejecting his earlier bail application he has filed letter of his resignation and its acceptance order.
He has already resigned from the post of Director on 01.02.2021.
Prosecution has failed to file any relevant document for his involvement in the aforesaid crime.
He has already been enlarged on bail from the different Courts in the offences of similar nature.
He is suffering jail incarceration since 13.10.2022.
Applicant is permanent resident of Distt. Jalandhar (Punjab).
Final conclusion of the trial is likely to take sufficient long time.
Hence, he prays that in view of the change circumstances applicant be enlarged on bail.

Per contra, learned Special Public Prosecutor for the EOW opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection by submitting that earlier bail application of applicant was rejected on merit, after considering all the facts and circumstance of the case.
Therefore, he does not deserve for bail.
Perused the impugned order of the trial Court as well as the case diary.

Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature and gravity of offence, arguments advanced by the both the parties and also taking note of the fact that it is found that this Court has rejected the earlier bail application of the applicant, after considering all the facts and circumstances of the case; this fact is also brought before this Court that applicant has resigned from the post of Director on 01.02.2021; although he has filed certain documents, but that documents may be considered at the time of evidence;
photocopy of the aforesaid documents cannot be considered at this stage; there is no material change in the circumstances in which the applicant may be entitled for bail.
In view of the above, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the present applicant.
Accordingly, this second repeat bail application preferred under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. is hereby rejected.
Certified copy as per rules.
